rationale: The claimant's basement suffered direct physical damage from flooding including structural damage (buckled hardwood floor), water-soaked drywall, and destroyed personal property (boxes), which are all characteristic of property damage claims.
claim_summary: Extensive basement flooding with approximately two inches of water causing buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot, and ruined stored boxes. Classified as high-severity property damage under active homeowners policy POL-1004 with $500 deductible and $750,000 coverage limit.

case_facts.water_depth: approximately two inches across entire basement
case_facts.damage_description: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, multiple stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery: discovered upon return from work trip
